<!-- This page is just a list of "cards". Each card is the small block of HTML
     between <div class="col"> ... </div></div></div>. To add a new edition,
     copy the top card (the newest), paste it above itself, and change the
     number, title, book, author, and link. -->

*The Marginalia* is a recurring literary essay series, published on LinkedIn, in which I revisit a book that has shaped my thinking. The name comes from my habit of writing in the margins of the books I read. Each edition is anchored by a quote and ends with a question for readers. Editions are listed newest first, and each card links to the full essay on LinkedIn.
